items.headline: Mistral releases Mistral OCR 4
items.summary: Mistral OCR 4 is a compact document-parsing model that returns text with bounding boxes, block classification and confidence scores across 170 languages. Mistral reports 85.20 on OlmOCRBench and a 72% average win rate in annotator preference tests; it is available via API at $4 per 1,000 pages.
